exposure: Epidural levobupivacaine combined with fentanyl (2.5 ug/kg)
Epidural levobupivacaine combined with sufentanil (1 ug/kg)
Intramuscular morphine (0.2 mg/kg) and intravenous propofol (as part of the general anesthetic protocol)
outcome: Neonatal Apgar score (at 5 and 60 minutes after birth)
Puppy mortality rate (until 24 hours after birth)
cohort: A total of 20 brachycephalic bitches (French and English bulldogs) undergoing elective cesarean-section.
finding: Compared to the levobupivacaine-sufentanil combination, levobupivacaine-fentanyl resulted in lower neonatal Apgar scores at 5 minutes post-birth, although both protocols provided minimal maternal and neonatal adverse effects and required propofol supplementation for complete C-section performance.
